zones: Converter Chain Fallback and AGPL Gating
waves.rationale: Verdict-Gate defines the foundational contracts (TreeGateResult in helpers/types.py, thresholds in config.py) that the Garble zone's tree_validation.validate_tree() imports directly (confirmed via trace_path: validate_tree -> TreeGateResult). It must land first. Converter Chain (indexer.py/pipeline.py/normalize.py) shares no key files and no symbol dependency with Verdict-Gate (search_graph shows disjoint result sets), so it is safe to run in parallel in the same wave. Placing it here also pre-empts the file-overlap conflict it would otherwise create with OCR Recovery (both touch indexer.py) by separating them into different waves up front.

Consumes the TreeGateResult/threshold contract fixed in Wave 1 (validate_tree in tree_validation.py calls into helpers/types.py and helpers/garble.py's detect_garble/garble_prongs chain, confirmed via trace_path). Runs alone because two of its key files (converters/pictures.py and client/recovery.py) are also PRIMARY files for the OCR Recovery zone (Wave 3) and Wave 1's Converter Chain zone claims indexer.py which recovery.py/pictures.py interact with at runtime -- isolating Garble Detection to its own wave prevents a same-file merge collision with either neighbor.

zones: OCR Recovery Cascade and Kill-Switch Conflation
Dual-Writer Verdict Persistence and Consistency Model Split
waves.rationale: OCR Recovery shares converters/pictures.py and client/recovery.py with Garble Detection (Wave 2) -- rule 1 forces a separate wave. It also shares client/indexer.py with the Converter Chain zone (Wave 1) -- already separated. Dual-Writer Verdict Persistence (storage/verdict.py, storage/documents.py, registry_mirror.py, reconcile.py, registry/queries.py) has zero file overlap with any other zone (search_graph/trace_path show storage.verdict.save_doc_meta and storage.documents.save_flat_doc as a disjoint call chain reached only from preprocess_client.py/promotion_sweep.py), but it structurally consumes the verdict fields produced by Wave 1's Verdict-Gate zone and the tree-quality outcome produced by Wave 2's Garble Detection zone (save_doc_meta merges verdict output before persisting), so it cannot run before either. It has no file conflict with OCR Recovery, so it co-runs in Wave 3.
